chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Zurara ibn A'yan and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When a man gathers four (wives), so he divorces one of them, so he cannot marry the fifth until the expiration of the waiting period of the wife he has divorced.
And he (peace be upon him) said: 'The man cannot gather his water (seed) in five (wives)'.

key_terms.عِدَّةُ: Waiting period (Iddah) after divorce or death

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a fifth wife before the waiting period of the first divorce ends?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the jurisprudential distinction between the maximum number of wives (four) and the condition for adding a fifth, requiring the completion of the 'iddah of the divorced wife before the new marriage is valid. Shia scholars interpret the phrase 'gathering water in five' as a prohibition on maintaining five simultaneous marital bonds, ensuring that the count of active wives does not exceed four at any given moment. This ruling underscores the importance of the waiting period in regulating polygynous unions within Shia fiqh.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Zurara Bin Ayn and Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the man gathers four (wives), so he divorces one of them, so he cannot marry the fifth until the expiration of the waiting period of the wife he has divorces’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The man cannot gather his water (seed) in five (wives)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah ibn ‘A‘yan and Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If a man accumulates four wives then divorces one, he cannot marry the fifth before the end of waiting period of the woman whom he has divorced.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘A man cannot deposit his water in five.’”
